title: Do transformed LP2 runes show a reliable period?
question: Does the reported period-238 coincidence peak survive a source-bound replay and controls that select the best transform and period?
reader_question: Is the period 238 signal a useful clue?
summary: A published period-238 peak reproduces. A planted 13-cycle yields a multiple of 13 under the same search, but its selected score is lower than most shuffle maxima.
finding: The pinned pages 27–32 two-step difference stream has normalized periodic coincidence 1.412285 at period 238, with source within-profile z 5.950736. One of 499 selected-maximum rune shuffles reaches the observed peak. A planted 13-cycle has very high period-13 coincidence (23.464); the ranking selects period 143 = 11 × 13, passing the literal frozen positive criterion. However, its selected standardized score falls below 452 shuffle maxima, so this score alone poorly distinguishes a known periodic source. The observed peak does not identify an encryption cycle.
limitations: The shuffle tail is conditional on the five-transform, eligible-period scan on pages 27–32. A nine-section selection bound does not cover the separate concatenated stream, other statistics, segmentation choices or prior source analyses. The planted control satisfies the period-multiple gate, but within-profile z is not a calibrated universal periodicity detector. This record does not test decryption.
next_steps: A proposed periodic cipher should specify a key, transformation and expected held-out decoding result, then pass a planted-control gate under a scorer selected before LP2 outcomes.

scope.representation: Nine pinned unsolved relikd rune sections (12,956 runes); pages 27–32 are the selected conditional-control section.
scope.procedure: Replay five source rune transformations, normalized periodic coincidence through 300 in each section and through 600 in the concatenation; independently measure fourgram spacings and word boundaries. Shuffle pages 27–32 rune order 499 times, taking the maximum within-profile z across all five transforms and periods, then test a planted 13-cycle.
scope.parameters: GP29; at least six symbols per residue column; random.Random seeds 330103 and 1330; 499 shuffles.
scope.exclusions: Other text sources, other selection families, alternate word boundaries, full-page plaintext tests and all decryption claims.

review.kind: computational source replay and instrument audit

reproduction.environment: Python 3.9+ with NumPy and Numba for the full scan; independent checker uses the standard library. PATH is a pinned relikd checkout and all nine input hashes are verified.

sources.label: Pinned Leo test and source receipt
